name: silvershop/withdrawal
description: EU/NL right-of-withdrawal (herroepingsknop) for SilverShop: a persistent, guest-capable withdrawal button available for the whole 14-day cooling-off window, a minimal no-account withdrawal form, an immediate on-screen + emailed confirmation, and a per-line exemption contract. Defensible-design machinery — verify the statutory copy, deadlines and exemptions with legal/DPO before launch.

suggest.silvershop/order-confirmation: Provides the opaque GuestToken the guest online-withdrawal function reuses. Required for the guest one-click button; without it only logged-in members self-serve (guests fall back to the model-form / email route).
suggest.silvershop/invoicing: Automatic credit-note on refund — the withdrawal records/links the resulting ShopCreditMemo.
suggest.silvershop/ledger: Posts the refund credit-memo to the ledger (via invoicing).
suggest.silvershop/notification-log: Logs the withdrawal-confirmation email (durable-medium audit) from the stamped X-SilverShop-Notification-Key header.
suggest.silvershop/personalisation: Flags personalised lines as withdrawal-exempt (CRD Art. 16(c)) through the updateWithdrawable hook.
suggest.silvershop/product-status: Flags made-to-order lines as withdrawal-exempt (CRD Art. 16(c)) through the updateWithdrawable hook.
suggest.silvershop/storefront: Ships the styled button / form / confirmation templates (this module ships functional fallbacks only).
suggest.silvershop/order-admin: Surfaces the withdrawal tab / badges in the modern order screen.
